$comment: MACHINE-READABLE COMPLIANCE MANIFEST — single source of truth.
Legal pages, the cookie banner, the consent log, and the data export all
read from this file. `npm run verify` fails when code and this file
disagree (retention windows, cookie categories, enabled regimes).
Edit values here, never inside the policy markdown templates.

product.disputeVenue: the courts of Example City, Country

regimes.$comment: Enable only what applies. Each enabled regime must have its policy pages and its data-subject endpoints live; verify enforces that.

$notes.gdpr: EU/EEA users → lawful basis, Art. 15 access, Art. 17 erasure, Art. 30 records, DPAs, transfer mechanism.
$notes.ukGdpr: UK users → ICO registration may be required; UK IDTA for transfers.
$notes.ccpaCpra: California users → 'Do Not Sell or Share', disclosure of categories, 12-month lookback.
$notes.coppa: Under-13 users (US) → verifiable parental consent. Leave false unless you truly serve children.
$notes.aiActTransparency: EU AI Act Art. 50 → disclose AI-generated content to end users.
$notes.pciDss: Set true only if card data touches your servers. Using a hosted checkout keeps you at SAQ-A.

dataInventory.examples: Email address, display name, avatar URL
dataInventory.purpose: Creating and securing your account, signing you in, service emails
dataInventory.retention: Until you delete your account, then 30 days in a recoverable state

dataInventory.purpose: Proving it is you and keeping sessions secure
dataInventory.retention: Sessions expire after 30 days; hashes are deleted with the account

dataInventory.examples: IP address, user agent, pages viewed (only if analytics consent is given)
dataInventory.purpose: Security, rate limiting, and aggregate product analytics
dataInventory.lawfulBasis: Consent for analytics; legitimate interests for security
dataInventory.recipients: Analytics provider (only with consent), hosting provider

dataInventory.examples: Which cookie categories you accepted, when, and from which IP
dataInventory.purpose: Demonstrating that consent was properly obtained

dataInventory.examples: Customer id, plan, invoice history (card numbers never reach our servers)
dataInventory.purpose: Charging for paid plans and meeting tax obligations

dataInventory.examples: Messages you send us, attachments you include
dataInventory.purpose: Answering your questions and resolving disputes

subprocessors.name: Hosting provider
subprocessors.dataCategories: All data stored by the service

subprocessors.name: Payment processor
subprocessors.$comment: Remove this entry if you do not take payments.

cookies.name: __Host-oauth_state
cookies.purpose: Prevents cross-site request forgery during sign-in

cookies.name: spawnpoint.consent
cookies.purpose: Remembers your cookie choices (local storage, not a cookie)

cookies.name: _ga / analytics cookie
cookies.purpose: Counts visits and page views in aggregate
cookies.$comment: Loaded ONLY after analytics consent. See client/src/lib/analytics.ts.

retention.$comment: From legal/compliance.json → session retention and users.purgeDeleted and consents.prune verify against these numbers.

transfers.mechanism: Standard Contractual Clauses and, where available, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework
transfers.additionalSafeguards: Encryption in transit and at rest, data minimisation, access on a need-to-know basis

security.passwordHashing: scrypt (N=2^15, r=8, p=1) with per-user salt
security.incidentResponseCommitment: We notify affected users and supervisory authorities within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.
security.disclosurePolicy: Coordinated disclosure. We publish a hall-of-fame entry, and we will not pursue legal action against good-faith research.

ai.humanReview: Model output is presented as a draft only; nothing is published or billed automatically without a human action.
ai.disclosureText: Some content in this product is generated by an AI model. It can be wrong. Verify anything important before acting on it.

accessibility.knownLimitations: Some third-party embedded content is not yet fully labelled; keyboard access to the chart tooltips is partial.
